claims.claim: The full odd static response and projected bound components are explicit; the second harmonic reduces to a specified localized outgoing source.
The localized second-harmonic residual has nonzero on-shell transform throughout the band and its outgoing response has nonlocalized oscillatory tails.
The projected direct cubic threshold defect is -27/35, using convergent subtracted integrals.
Finite-energy packet/history matching to the actual cubic trace and modal action errors remain unproved.
